Name: Shishak, King of Egypt
Summary: Shishak, king of Egypt, came up against Jerusalem in Rehoboam's fifth year with 1,200 chariots and 60,000 horsemen, and carried away the treasures of the house of the LORD and the king's house.
KeyStory: Because Judah had forsaken the LORD, Shishak took the fenced cities of Judah and stripped Jerusalem of Solomon's shields of gold.
LifeLesson: Forsaking the LORD leaves even a fortified kingdom open to its enemies.
